title: CAPA-for-refusals: an open tool to measure chance-adjusted agreement of safety decisions across models

original_idea.body: Python library computing chance-adjusted agreement + redundancy score for binary refuse/comply matrices (arXiv:2502.04313).

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Useful auditing tooling but impact is one step removed (enables measurement).

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Small Python stats library; metric design needs care.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused deliverable (pip package + validation), depends on SafetyInfinity labels.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Neglected auditing infra labs won't build against redundancy claims.

low_compute.reasoning: Pure analysis on a label matrix; CPU/free-tier.

novelty.reasoning: Adapts CAPA to refusals; moderate extension.
